name: smjob filter help

help_strings.text:
This udw command enables filtering the output of the job tracker for specified SUID(s).

usage: sm_dispatch_job filter [action] SUID

Available actions:
  1) disable -> Allow job tracking output for the specified SUID
  2) enable  -> Suppress job tracking output for the specified SUID
  3) except  -> Suppress job tracking output for all but the specifed SUID
  4) only    -> Allow job tracking output for only the specified SUID
  5) show    -> Display filtering status for the specified SUID
                If called without a SUID, displays filtering status for all

review: Reads 16-bit MMIO BD071C18, BD071C1A, BD066404, BD066408, BD066402, BD073416, BD073412, BD073414. Prints LHCFifo state/control/DMA counters; no MMIO store or start/reset/motion call in handler. A00292A8 temporarily changes interrupt mask and restores it after snapshot.
limitation: Peripheral read side effects are not formally proved from register documentation; this is the firmware-provided diagnostic snapshot.

run_order: Final native batch command, followed by one previously successful status query and prompt verification.
exact_side_effect: Emits character byte 0xFF through the normal shell printf/output route; returns 0. No reset register, baud/divisor setter, COM reopen, OS restart, or NVM write is called by this handler.
interpretation: Registered description says Reset the text formatting of the uart. Byte 0xFF is the requested output formatting control; downstream driver/terminal rendering is not inferred to equal board reset.
capture_requirement: Preserve raw bytes; a text decoder may display replacement character or nothing for FF.
recovery: No power cycle is expected from this handler. Verify receipt of the return/prompt and next ordinary status query. If that fails, stop the active batch and inspect raw/passive UART output before taking any stronger recovery action.

name: jm_urf.get_perf_timers
purpose: Capture four existing performance counters, then clear those volatile counters.
control_flow_proof: A024051A loads four words from RAM0x20A44774, formats total job/decompression/refill/I/O times, writes output. A024054E..A0240556 then stores four zero words to the same16-byte RAM block. No persistent storage, network, firmware update, scan, or motor calls.

side_effect.clear_occurs: After UART payload emission inside handler

capture_requirement: Keep exact first response as evidence of the pre-clear values. Do not retry after a valid prompt-returned capture merely to repeat output.
authorization_basis: User requested complete real command testing; parent explicitly authorized this low-impact read-and-clear operation.

hardware_access: Only registered data-store read callback; no scanner hardware control requested.

name: escl.get_remote_scan_state
hold_if: Missing/malformed response, wrong/NULL name, nonzero array metadata, or value outside0/1. A raw ds2.get zero alone is not proof that the ID exists.

Live scalar checks and static width1 descriptor establish the admitted branch. No scan request is emitted.
hardware_access: Data-store state read only.

name: webfwupdate.get_base_md
purpose: Read the 16-byte base firmware digest and any matching base_md entry in local secure configuration.
review_evidence: A0470EEA reads 16 bytes from the existing base-MD pointer at 20E09780 and formats 32 hex characters via A046ED8A. It then requests section web_product_update/key base_md with a 65-byte output buffer through A03C8882/A03C8696. name: heapmgr log block
argument_syntax: lookup flags=0, key high word=16777216 (0x01000000), key low word=1
purpose: Read allocator purgeability, lock flag, client/priority fields, pin count and size for the existing root-directory block.

A0160802..089A calls A015FB5A six times with selectors1,3,2,5,6,7, each output pointing into its own stack. Selector0/4 and all property setters are unreachable. It formats one bounded metadata line and waits one RTOS tick.

A015FCF4 hashes eight key bytes with A015FB80 -> A000723C CRC and standard remainder trampoline A0025294, reads one of211 initialized buckets, and traverses existing links. A015FBF2 -> A0160D36 -> A015F3D6 resolves an existing descriptor and A016005A copies eight bytes to a local key buffer; A0010550 compares exactly eight bytes. A015FB92 -> A0160D36 -> A016007E reads the next existing link. No hash insert/remove or allocator path is reachable.

On a key match A0160D48 reads descriptor generation into caller-local storage. A0160D1A -> A0160C60 -> A015F3D6 checks index, non-null header and generation, then reads the existing header pointer. The successful branch was physically exercised for this exact key by ram.block_info in physical61, and the whole hash index was captured in physical58 (8 entries, this block index1 in bucket118).

A0160004 reads selected header fields: selector1=byte26 bit0 purgeable, selector3=byte24 client/major priority field, selector2=byte25 minor priority, selector5=word8 size, selector6=byte27 pin/use count, selector7=byte26 bit1 lock. Its only writes are to each caller-provided stack output.

A0161270 formats into a256-byte stack buffer, gets length, and calls provider vtable+24. Physical57 resolves 20943A40 -> A061F594 -> A061F598; +24=A0431A59 -> A02C2A7A UART writer; parser+10=A0431979 -> A02C3DE2 decimal parser. The fixed line format and integer arguments fit the formatting buffer.

A02F6D70(1) checks scheduler state through A02F7144 and invokes the established RTOS delay A04E6650. This updates volatile current-thread delay/scheduler counters for one tick and returns; it does not access storage or command actuators. This delay path is already used by captured heap tree diagnostics.

All operations are reads with paired volatile lock bookkeeping reviewed in round6.

Physical79 proves words[2,0], flags[0,0]; each chute therefore returnsfalse from this predicate. The selected branchA0321CEC calls A03204AC(chute,0x28), reads a cached DS2 value and returns its low byte. The deeper lazy ink-cache/transaction branchA0321C0E is excluded by this observed guard; no such helper is claimed generally safe.

A03AE1E0 reads park override20858300; if zero it callsA03A55C8. Nonzero predicate returnsorigin+0x59; zero predicate reads the position getter with index0. A03AE204 selects nonzero white override20D9F280 or cached20D9F218 and addsorigin208582D4. A03AE216 selects nonzero black override20D9F284 or cached20D9F220 and adds the sameorigin.
